title: Redfin Scraper: For Sale & Sold Homes, Price Changes
description: Scrape Redfin homes for sale and recently sold from any Redfin search URL or ZIP code: price, status, sold date, beds, baths, sq ft, $/sq ft, HOA, year built, days on market, lat/long, remarks. Tracks price drops between runs and splits big areas past the 350-home cap.
